caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The object is a cylindrical container with an ornate lattice design on its sides, featuring small geometric holes and arched window-like patterns. The container is primarily metallic, with shades of bronze, green, and hints of reddish-brown at the base. On top of the cylinder sits a sculpted frog, also colored in shades of dark green and brown, with clear detailing on its limbs, eyes, and texture. The frog’s posture is alert, with the front legs slightly raised and head tilted upward. The base of the cylinder is bordered with a thick green ring that sits above a reddish-brown bottom edge. The artist’s signature, "w.o. Fletcher," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Frog
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
